description: Gateway REST API bind host precedence. Read by internal/config (APIBindHost) and cli/defenseclaw/config.py (api_bind_host) so the listener and every CLI client agree: an explicit gateway.api_bind wins, else loopback. guardrail.host never moves the API (the retired openshell-sandbox standalone mode did; the config_version 9 migration resets it).

cases.name: guardrail host never moves the API
